integration: fast-forward of research/r69-observable-physics-bridges-20261118 to b79b9526b (no local commits after bd0c6f492)
reviewer: one separate read-only reviewer in fresh context (AGENTS.md step 6). Its probes under /tmp were not durable. Post-fix numbers below come from R108 files or tests; the pre-fix values quoted for R4 (6.8e-14, 6.6e-13 and 4.45e-9) come from non-durable probes of the pre-fix code (lead and reviewer) and are not file-backed.

findings.defect: read result.history['iterations']; the solver writes 'picard_iterations', so every coupled run failed closed
findings.evidence: F1 run: 1 failed / 42 passed, ValueError 'coupled result has no recorded history' (logs F1_pytest.log)
findings.resolution: read 'picard_iterations'; fail-closed check kept; test_history_from_coupled_result_refuses_a_non_moving_collision_model also pins the key

findings.defect: first-pass bound 2e-2 at 48 cells was never measured; measured T2 3.06e-2 fails
findings.evidence: F2_COUPLED_LOS.json: cell-end source nodes give T2 3.06e-2, 7.98e-3, 2.01e-3, 5.24e-4 at 48/96/192/384 cells; per-doubling ratios are written by scripts/r108/review_r107_claims.py into REVIEW/R107_CLAIM_CHECK.json (3.83 to 4.01, second order); the native amplitude moves far less, so the error sits in the source sampling
findings.resolution: solver records the photon state after every optical substep of cells within depth 40 of the observer (history_substep_tau_max) and history_from_coupled_result inserts them as source nodes (default); test runs at 192 cells with 3x the measured 192-cell values for both node sets (substeps: T1 4.68e-4, T2 1.18e-3, E2 2.81e-3, B2 3.04e-3; cell ends: T1 2.87e-3, T2 6.04e-3, E2 1.82e-2, B2 1.993e-2)

findings.defect: the published template is written in incoming-photon angles (McEwen et al. 2006 below eq. A3; Kogut et al. 1997 footnote 2) but the module did not say so; evaluating it at sky directions gives f(-n), which equals the other handedness composed with a pi rotation, so a rotation-and-handedness fit silently picks the wrong handedness
findings.evidence: test_sky_directions_use_the_incoming_photon_convention: sky map equals template at -n and equals the opposite-handedness template at R_x(pi) n to 1e-12; the naive evaluation differs at O(1)
findings.resolution: bjs_temperature_sky(directions, p) for outward sky directions; docstring states the convention

findings.defect: Delta = lnE + N with lnE accumulated over |N| ~ 7 lost one ulp per RK4 step; T formed as (accT - 1)/4
findings.evidence: test_redshift_accumulation_has_no_step_dependent_rounding_floor: Bianchi I, shear 1e-10, T error below 1e-14 and independent of the ray step after the fix (pre-fix non-durable probe: 6.8e-14 at step 0.02, 6.6e-13 at 0.002); REVIEW/R107_CLAIM_CHECK.json native-vs-HEALPix T agreement 1.07e-10 with the fixed code
findings.resolution: Delta accumulated directly from stage rates dlnE/dN + 1; F_T = expm1(-4 Delta) + 4 T red, observed increment summed without the 1 - 1 cancellation (identical in exact arithmetic)

findings.defect: with automatic source_ell_max the truncation check can never trip
findings.resolution: emission on the top native shell (ell = L_native >= 4) is checked against max_source_truncation and reported as top_shell_relative_norm
